title: Chainsaw
summary: Sam’s close-range weapon. Keep cutting without using any ammo.

sections.title: In the field
sections.text: The original NETRICSA entry describes a forestry tool repurposed for fighting monsters. Its short reach makes positioning essential.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Get close and hold fire. The PC port gives the chainsaw twice its original reach.

coverage: You start with the chainsaw, so it has no pickup locations. Its longer reach is a PC addition.

title: Schofield Pistol
summary: A dependable revolver and the first firearm you find in the campaign.

sections.title: In the field
sections.text: NETRICSA presents the Schofield as Sam's dependable old-fashioned sidearm. A pistol pickup is available in the Upper Temple of Herkat.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Press 2 to select it. Enable Alternate weapons in Extras for the optional Colts. Once you have both, press 2 again to switch between one and two.

title: Double Barrel Coach Gun
summary: A powerful close-range shotgun with a pause between blasts.

sections.title: In the field
sections.text: The original briefing emphasizes the coach gun's short-range power. Its firing cycle leaves a pause between blasts.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Fires both shells when you have them, or a single shot when only one remains. The Alternate weapons option changes its spread.

title: Thompson Sub Machine Gun
summary: An automatic weapon for keeping groups of enemies under fire.

sections.title: In the field
sections.text: NETRICSA describes the Thompson as a classic trench sweeper suited to nearby and medium-range threats.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Hold fire to keep shooting while you have ammo. Let go to stop.

title: Mini Gun
summary: A fast-firing gun that gets through enemies—and your ammo—quickly.

sections.title: In the field
sections.text: The original tips call attention to its heavy ammunition use. It is introduced early in the Pyramid Entrance Maze.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Hold fire for a steady stream of bullets. The barrels wind down when you stop.

title: Rocket Launcher
summary: Fires rockets that hurt enemies near the blast as well as the target.

sections.title: In the field
sections.text: The original description combines direct projectile damage with an explosion around the impact. Reloading separates each launch.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Aim with the mouse, including up and down. Once fired, a rocket keeps going in that direction.

title: Rogue Prion Gun
summary: Makes affected enemies attack nearby targets while their health drains away.

sections.title: In the field
sections.text: NETRICSA describes this weapon as breaking Mental’s control over his troops. The effect also slowly drains the affected enemy’s health.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Affected enemies move and act twice as fast in the PC port. They can turn on other enemies, but Sam can still become their target.

title: Uni-Directional Microwave Transmitter
summary: A heavy blast weapon with a bright flash and a pause between attacks.

sections.title: In the field
sections.text: The original fiction describes a repurposed communications device that heats its targets. Its familiar pickup label is U.M.T.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Deals heavy damage to regular enemies it can target. It does not hurt players or either boss.

title: Time Strike
summary: Drops a heavy object onto an enemy’s position.

sections.title: In the field
sections.text: Scientists send heavy objects back through time to the spot Sam aims at.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Aim at a living enemy. A successful shot marks its position, so a moving enemy can get away. An attempt with no valid target uses no ammo; tougher enemies may survive a hit.

title: SBC Cannon
summary: Fires a cannonball that can bounce off walls and plough through enemies.

sections.title: In the field
sections.text: The original NETRICSA entry highlights the cannonball's ricochets and ability to plow through a group.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: A cannonball can hit several enemies before it finally explodes.

title: Beheaded Kamikaze
summary: Runs straight at you with bombs in hand.

sections.title: In the field
sections.text: The original intel describes a reanimated attacker carrying bombs. Its cry provides an audible warning of the approaching threat.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Listen for its scream and keep your distance. It explodes when it gets close enough, hurting anyone nearby.

title: Sirian Werebull
summary: A charging beast that can knock Sam back.

sections.title: In the field
sections.text: NETRICSA recommends dodging the charge and taking advantage of the time it needs to turn for another approach.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Dodge the charge, then use the time it takes to turn around to attack.

title: Methug Soldier
summary: A floating soldier that fires bolts and hurts Sam on contact.

sections.title: In the field
sections.text: The original intel describes its useless trailing legs and the bolt fired from its body. It is among the first enemies encountered in the campaign.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Watch for its shots and avoid letting it float into you.

title: Methug Commander
summary: A small hovering Methug with a dangerous touch.

sections.title: In the field
sections.text: NETRICSA describes a commander associated with other Methugs. Its eye and suspended body distinguish it from the soldier.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Keep it at a distance. It attacks on contact; despite the original guide’s description, it does not fire an eye bolt in the game.

title: Cyclops
summary: A fast-moving, one-eyed enemy with club-like arms.

sections.title: In the field
sections.text: The original intel emphasizes the danger of letting this fast-moving creature reach Sam.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: It can shoot as well as hurt Sam up close. Keep moving and watch the distance between you.

title: Bladder Beast
summary: A swollen Methug relative that attacks with spit.

sections.title: In the field
sections.text: NETRICSA attributes its unusual movement to inflatable body sacs and describes a corrosive ranged attack.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Avoid its shots and keep clear of its body, which can also hurt Sam.

title: Aludran Arachnoid
summary: A scorpion-like enemy that opens fire from a distance.

sections.title: In the field
sections.text: The original dossier describes an armed, many-legged hybrid that prefers to open fire from a distance.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Watch for incoming shots before moving closer. Contact with it also hurts.

title: Aludran Reptiloid
summary: A tough enemy that often attacks from far away.

sections.title: In the field
sections.text: The original briefing describes rapid acid-missile attacks and recommends heavy weapons against this durable enemy.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Bring a heavy weapon and keep an eye on higher ledges. It can aim down at Sam from above.

title: Hermit Crabuloid
summary: A shelled enemy that hides, emerges and attacks.

sections.title: In the field
sections.text: NETRICSA describes the shell as protection and directs attention to the vulnerable body revealed while the creature is active.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Watch for it to come out of hiding. It can jump as it gets close.

title: Gunrilla
summary: A heavily armed gorilla mutant with a cannon built into its body.

sections.title: In the field
sections.text: The original description portrays a slow, heavily armed opponent that is dangerous both at range and up close.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Dodge its cannonballs and avoid its strong close-range attack.

title: Sirian Sphinx
summary: The boss waiting at the end of the Egyptian chapter.

sections.title: Encounter
sections.text: The Sphinx has its own health bar and battle music. Be ready to deal with the enemies it summons.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Fight it in the sixth campaign level. It alternates between firing volleys and calling in reinforcements.

title: Wolfiator
summary: The armoured boss at the end of the Roman chapter.

sections.title: Encounter
sections.text: A towering enemy in a plumed helmet, backed by summoned minions.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Fight it in Caesar’s Palace, the final campaign level. Expect five-shot volleys and waves of reinforcements. The full campaign is still being playtested.
